deviations.what: The lint's 'within_s >= 120' is applied to the window width within_s - not_before_s (and within_s >= not_before_s); not_before_s a multiple of 30 s; both only in strict (lint) mode
deviations.why: 8.5's own anticipation example {not_before_s: -900, within_s: 0} would fail the literal rule; the engine runs any well-formed item

deviations.what: Defaults chosen where 8.5 is silent: hold 'end' (0 = no requirement), if_no_trigger 'forbid' plus an explicit third value 'allow', initially 'false'; label and within_s required
deviations.why: hard by default (P2); authors opt out explicitly

deviations.what: Labels follow the table literally and are reported as if the run ended now (late before hi is reported, not decided); an early close that still holds through the window gives early and late
deviations.why: matches 8.5's conditions and the existing response_open convention; decided() carries the 'decided at' column

deviations.what: A milestone-name trigger/act reads the milestone's live per-sample truth (held_for_s included), not its latched first-reach time
deviations.why: 'the maximal intervals during which it held' needs the live value; a latched milestone would never end an interval

deviations.what: Open-interval attribution by sample point (action / standing-order sample = robot) instead of WP2's writer log; by is robot|other|setup
deviations.why: the engine samples right after the robot's window, so it is exact and independent of when WP2's per-step diff reaches env.writes; the ledger's writer_of_by maps other to physical

deviations.what: unattended_s (the key WP1's ledger reads) is computed for every item matching any zero_when_protected class; zone = rooms in connects (else its room); near_m measured from the room the robot reaches the gate from (geometry.anchor)
deviations.why: keeps the ledger's 0 s rule fed whichever matching class it names first; 6.9 leaves zone and distance open
